components.name: ExpandableTabs
components.doc: Icon tabs that spend their width on the active tab only: its label unfolds on a spring while the others fold back to icons, so five destinations fit where two labeled tabs would. Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

components.name: ExpandableTabsPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: a compact app screen with five destinations in its bottom bar.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text shown only while the tab is active; always the tab's accessible name.

members.name: badge
members.doc: Small count on the icon, for unread items and the like.

members.name: content
members.doc: Panel shown while the tab is active. Leave it out to use the tabs as a plain switcher.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: A disabled tab cannot be picked and is skipped by the arrow keys.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Active tab id on first render (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the tab that was picked.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the tab list.
